## The bar

Engineering is the one place a losing option keeps its full argument, because
someone will come back with it in six months and the argument will have to be had
again from scratch otherwise.

But not everything rejected earns a record. The test is: **would a competent
person, arriving fresh, propose this?** If yes, it gets a record. If it lost
because it was obviously worse, a line on the unit doc is enough.

## Per record

- A **number** and a **slug** — the id is `docs/engineering/decisions/NNNN-slug`.
- **The decision**, in one sentence, in the active voice.
- **What was rejected**, argued at its best. A decision record that straw-mans the
  loser is the reason the argument comes back.
- **Why it lost** — against which criterion, with the score if the exploration
  produced one.
- **What would make us revisit.** This is the field people skip and the field
  that makes the record useful: name the condition, not a date.

## What to produce

`decisions` — one entry per record, with those five fields.
